why: Both extend ot-judges-v7-3; S02 adds 7:2, the opening of the Lord's order.
Both extend ot-1-samuel-v26-9; S02 adds Abishai's proposal (26:8) that the prohibition answers.
Same execution order; S02 widens it back to David's oath at 4:9 (its note: not a second record).
Both extend ot-1-kings-v17-13; S03 adds the Lord's promise (17:14).
Both extend ot-1-kings-v20-9; S03 adds 20:8, where Jezebel writes and sends the letters.
Both extend ot-2-kings-v6-2; S03 adds 6:1, the opening of the same request.
Same letter of Jehu; S03 widens it to 10:1 where he writes it (its note: one record, not two).
Both extend ot-2-kings-v10-19; S03 adds the feigned pledge at 10:18.
Same divine word; S03 widens it to 7:12 where the Lord appears and begins (its note: one record).
Both extend AUD-16-6-21 (6:21–28) on opposite sides; combined extension per S04 note.
Same saying of Eliphaz; S05 adds 4:9, which completes it (its note: merge, no second record).
Same beatitude; S05 adds its closing line 127:4 (its note: merge, no second record).
Both extend ot-sirach-v19-6 (19:6–8); notes give the combined extension 19:5–9.
Both extend ot-sirach-v42-11 (42:11–12); notes give the combined extension 42:9–14.
Both extend ot-sirach-v43-29 (43:29–30); notes give the combined extension 43:27–33.
Both extend K021; S07 adds the Pharisees' question (9:11).
Both extend K049; S07 adds the lawyer's question (10:29).
Both extend K032; S08 starts at the first 'born from above' saying (3:3).
Arrest order (7:32) and rebuke for not carrying it out (7:45–49) are one directive; S08 note asks for one record.
Same suborning of false witnesses against Stephen; S08 adds 6:11 (its note: widen to 6:11–14).
Both extend X011 (3:2–3); together the record becomes the whole Sardis letter, as both notes say.
Baptism voice in Matthew, Mark, Luke; Matthew primary (neighbour AUD-44-3-7 is Matthew).
Temptation demands; Matthew 4:3–9 is the fullest single finding (Luke's split into 4:3–7 and 4:9–11).
Centurion's servant (Matt 8:5–13 // Luke 7:1–10); neighbours mixed, Matthew primary.
Same order to cross before the storm; Mark primary: the catalogue uses Mark for this sequence (AUD-45-4-23, AUD-45-5-18).
Same would-be follower saying; Luke primary because neighbour K038 is Luke 9:59–62 (Matt 8:21–22 linked there).
Storm rebuke in three Gospels; Mark primary like the rest of the sequence (AUD-45-5-18).
Gerasene demons sent into the pigs; Mark primary: the pericope's existing record AUD-45-5-18 is Mark.
Gerasene townspeople beg Jesus to leave; Mark primary per AUD-45-5-18.
Healing of the bleeding woman; Luke primary: the surrounding Jairus record AUD-46-8-50 is Luke.
Same saying on division within households (Matt 10:34–36 // Luke 12:51–53); Matthew primary.
Children in the marketplace; Luke primary: neighbours AUD-46-7-22 and AUD-46-7-24 are Luke.
Woes on Chorazin and Bethsaida; Luke primary: same discourse as AUD-46-10-1 (Luke 10:1–12).
Beelzebul teaching incl. returning spirit (Luke 11:24–26 = Matt 12:43–45); Matthew primary per AUD-44-12-31.
Sign of Jonah, Nineveh and the queen of the South; Matthew primary.
Blessed are the eyes that see; Luke primary: neighbours K101 and K049 are Luke, Matthew 13's sower links to Luke's AUD-46-8-8.
Mustard seed and leaven; Matthew primary (kingdom-parable records AUD-44-13-44/51 are Matthew).
Prophet without honour at Nazareth; Luke primary: the same pericope's record AUD-46-4-16 is Luke.
Herodias' daughter demands John's head; Matthew primary (C0586 already links Matt 14:3–4).
Herod orders John beheaded; Matthew primary.
Disciples sent ahead by boat after the feeding; Matthew primary.
Walking on the sea: 'It is I; do not fear'; Matthew primary.
Canaanite/Syrophoenician woman; Matthew primary.
Weather-signs saying (Luke 12:54–56); Mark 8:11–13 is the same sign-demand occasion as Matt 16:1–4.
Get behind me, Satan; Matthew primary (neighbours K036, AUD-44-16-20 are Matthew).
Peter's three tents; Matthew primary: the pericope's record AUD-44-17-5 is Matthew.
Healing of the convulsed boy; Matthew primary.
Request of Zebedee's sons; Matthew primary (K054 follows, Matthew).
Blind man (men) at Jericho; Matthew primary (K054 precedes, Matthew).
Question of Jesus' authority; Matthew primary (AUD-44-21-28 follows).
Parable of the tenants; Matthew primary (AUD-44-21-28 precedes).
Wedding feast / great supper parable; neighbours mixed, Matthew primary.
Answer to the Sadducees on resurrection; Matthew primary (K078, K003 neighbours).
Woe for the key of knowledge; Matthew primary (Matthew 23 woes are Matthew records).
Woe on the prophets' tomb-builders; Matthew primary.
Council plots Jesus' arrest; Matthew primary.
Judas offers to betray Jesus; Matthew primary.
Woe to the betrayer at the supper; Matthew primary.
Judas's kiss and 'Seize him'; Matthew primary.
Council condemns Jesus (Luke 22:66–71 is Luke's account); Matthew primary.
Captors demand 'Prophesy!'; Matthew primary.
Passover release custom; John primary: neighbours AUD-47-18-28 and AUD-47-19-6 are John.
Pilate's sentence (no John finding); Matthew primary.
Simon of Cyrene compelled; Matthew primary.
Taunts to come down from the cross; Matthew primary.
'Let us see whether Elijah comes'; Matthew primary.
Joseph of Arimathea asks for the body; Matthew primary (neighbour AUD-44-27-62 is Matthew).
John 18:14 recalls Caiaphas's counsel of 11:49–50 (S08 note: Additional Scripture, not a record).
Caleb's offer of Achsah, told in Joshua 15 and Judges 1; Joshua primary.
Same call to bless the Lord repeated in Deborah's song (both notes say 5:9 repeats 5:2).
Elders anoint David at Hebron (1 Chr 11:3); Samuel primary, fuller.
David's order against Zion's Jebusites ('whoever strikes a Jebusite'), 1 Chr 11:6; Samuel primary.
David sends Joab and the army against Ammon (1 Chr 19:8); Samuel primary.
Water from Bethlehem's well (1 Chr 11:17–19); Samuel primary.
Benaiah appointed over David's guard (1 Chr 11:25); Samuel primary.
Solomon's labour levy and 3,600 overseers (2 Chr 2:16–17); Kings primary, fuller.
Israel asks Rehoboam to lighten the yoke (2 Chr 10:4); Kings primary.
Elders' counsel to Rehoboam (2 Chr 10:7); Kings primary, fuller.
Secession cry 'To your tents, Israel' (2 Chr 10:16); Kings primary.
Rehoboam sends Adoniram (2 Chr 10:18); Kings primary.
Jehoshaphat asks to inquire of the Lord first (2 Chr 18:4); Kings primary.
Messenger urges Micaiah to agree with the prophets (2 Chr 18:12); Kings primary.
Ahab adjures Micaiah to speak the truth (2 Chr 18:15); Kings primary.
Jehoiada crowns and anoints Joash (2 Chr 23:11); Kings primary.
Jehoiada's covenant of king and people (2 Chr 23:16); Kings primary.
Hezekiah's decree of worship at one altar, quoted by the envoy (2 Chr 32:12); Kings primary.
Envoy's wager of horses (Isaiah 36:8); Kings primary.
Josiah gathers the elders and reads the covenant book (2 Chr 34:29–30); Kings primary.
Josiah's covenant to keep the commandments (2 Chr 34:31–32); Kings primary.
Neco makes Eliakim king as Jehoiakim (2 Chr 36:4); Kings primary.
Tribute levied and exacted at Pharaoh's command; Chronicles finding is fuller (levy and exaction, 36:3–4a).
Nebuchadnezzar installs Zedekiah; Chronicles finding is fuller (adds the oath, 36:13).
Gedaliah appointed over the remnant (Greek Jeremiah 47:7 = MT 40:7); Kings primary.
Governor's ruling on unproven priests, repeated at Nehemiah 7:65 (B10 note: one record); Ezra primary.
Antiochus's commission to the Mysarch Apollonius (1 Macc 1:29–30); 2 Maccabees states the orders, fuller.
Commission of Nicanor and Gorgias to destroy Judea (2 Macc 8:8–9, parallel account); 1 Maccabees primary.
Demetrius sends Nicanor against Judas (1 Macc 7:26); 2 Maccabees gives the fuller orders.
Nicanor's sworn threat against the temple unless Judas is handed over (2 Macc 14:31–33); 1 Maccabees primary.
Same beatitude 'Blessed the people whose God is the Lord' (Greek Psalm 143:15); earlier psalm primary.
Same Davidic covenant condition on David's sons (Greek Psalm 131:11–12); S05 note: link them.
Proverbs 15:20 repeats 10:1 (B12 notes: repeated, also proposed).
Proverbs 18:11 repeats 10:15 (B12 notes: repeated, also proposed).
Proverbs 14:25 repeats 14:5 (B12 notes: repeated, also proposed).
Proverbs 16:25 repeats 14:12 word for word (B12 notes: repeated, also proposed).

The sending in 2 Kings 18:17 = Isaiah 36:2, which S06#19 adds to the envoy Commission record ot-isaiah-v36-4.
Same maxim as Greek Psalm 110:10 and Proverbs 9:10, both proposed as parallels of AUD-20-28-28 (B12#9, S05#31).
